intertidal_analysis_short

tena

1 Overview

This document:

  • Loads and merges pH/TA/nutrients and fDOM datasets
  • Cleans data and applies outlier handling (IQR rule)
  • Summarizes by habitat and diel period
  • Creates PCA for seasonal drivers
  • Visualizes diel and habitat patterns (boxplots, TA–pH, fDOM heatmap)
  • Computes correlation matrices and significance masks
  • Runs ANOVAs
  • Visualizes ANOVA results and reassesses hypotheses

Reproducibility & Modularity
Kept times (which removes summer), and the control label (open ocean) are parameterized in the YAML params: so I can change inputs without editing code chunks.

2.1 Paths & Parameters

keep_times <- params$keep_times
control_label <- params$control_label

3 Data Loading & Merging

This section loads both fDOM and pH/nutrients CSVs, parses dates, and joins on shared identifiers. We keep all samples, regardless of missing data (full_join).

load_ok <- TRUE
tryCatch({
  data_ph <- read_csv(here::here("Data","Biogeochemistry","pHProbe_Data_calculated.csv"), na = c("NA", ""), show_col_types = FALSE) 
    #mutate(Sampling_Date = lubridate::mdy(Sampling_Date))
  data_fdom <- read_csv(here::here("Data","Biogeochemistry","fDOM_clean.csv"), na = c("NA", ""), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(Sampling_Date = lubridate::mdy(Sampling_Date))
  data_tidal <- read.csv(here::here("Data","tidal_exchange.csv")) %>%
    mutate(Sampling_Date = lubridate::mdy(Sampling_Date))

  data_merged <- full_join(
    data_ph,
    data_fdom,
    by = c("UniqueID", "Benthos", "Quad_ID", "Day_Night", "Sampling_Date", "Sampling_Time","Season")
  ) %>%
    mutate(Humic = UVHumic+VisibleHumic+MarineHumic,# make a column for humics
           Prot = Tryptophan+Tyrosine, # make a column for proteinaceaus fDOM
           NOx = NO3+NO2 # make a column of total N
           )
  data_merged <- data_merged %>%
    left_join(data_tidal, by = c("Sampling_Date", "Day_Night"))
  
  cat("Data loaded and merged successfully.\n")
  cat("Total merged samples:", nrow(data_merged), "\n")
}, error = function(e){
  load_ok <<- FALSE
  message("Error loading or merging files. Please check file paths and names.")
  message(e)
})
## Data loaded and merged successfully.
## Total merged samples: 332

stopifnot(load_ok)

4 Cleaning & Pre-processing

We declare variable sets for identifiers, water chemistry, nutrients, and fDOM components. We retain only Dawn and Dusk samples, coerce numeric columns, set factor orders, drop NA grouping levels, and apply the 1.5×IQR rule as a conservative outlier filter (replacing outliers with NA).

# Identifier variables
id_vars <- c("UniqueID", "Season", "Benthos", "Quad_ID", "Day_Night", "Sampling_Date", "Tide")

# Water chemistry variables (from pH probe file)
water_chem_vars <- c("Salinity", "pH", "TempInSitu", "TA")

# Nutrient variables (from pH probe file)
nutrient_vars <- c("NO3", "PO4", "SIL", "NO2", "NH4", "NOx")

# fDOM variables (from fDOM file)
#fdom_vars <- c("UVHumic", "Tyrosine", "VisibleHumic", "MarineHumic",
#               "Tryptophan", "FulvicAcid", "BIX", "HIX", "FI", "M_to_C")

# reduced variables
fdom_vars <- c("Humic","Prot", "BIX", "HIX", "M_to_C")

all_numeric_vars <- c(water_chem_vars, nutrient_vars, fdom_vars)

# only vars of interest
numeric_vars <- c("pH", "TA", "NOx", "Humic", "Prot", "BIX", "HIX", "M_to_C")

ratio_vars <- c("pH", "TA", "NOx", "NH4", "BIX", "HIX")
  
raw_vars <- c("pH", "TA", "NOx", "Humic", "Prot")

# Helper to IQR-filter a numeric vector (returning NA for outliers)
iqr_filter <- function(x){
  if(!is.numeric(x)) return(x)
  q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- q3 - q1
  lo <- q1 - 1.5 * iqr
  hi <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr
  ifelse(x < lo | x > hi, NA_real_, x)
}

# Cleaned dataset
data_clean <- data_merged %>%
  filter(Day_Night %in% keep_times) %>%
  select(-M_to_C) %>%
  mutate(M_to_C = MarineHumic / VisibleHumic) %>%
  select(all_of(id_vars), any_of(all_numeric_vars)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(all_numeric_vars), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(
    Benthos   = factor(Benthos, levels = c(control_label, "Rockweed", "Surfgrass", "Barnacle", "Mussel")),
    Day_Night = factor(Day_Night, levels = c("Dawn", "Dusk"))
  ) %>%
  drop_na(Benthos, Day_Night) %>%
  
  mutate(across(all_of(all_numeric_vars), iqr_filter))

5 Summary Statistics

Per habitat × diel period (and Season), we compute mean, SD, and sample size for all numeric variables.

data_summary <- data_clean %>%
  group_by(Benthos, Day_Night, Season) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(all_numeric_vars), list(mean = ~ mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
                                          sd   = ~ sd(., na.rm = TRUE),
                                          n    = ~ sum(!is.na(.))
    )),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

6 Background plots

6.1 Correlation Matrix

We compute a Pearson correlation matrix on complete cases and visualize it with significance masking.

cor_data <- data_clean %>% select(all_of(ratio_vars)) %>% drop_na()

colnames(cor_data) <- gsub("M_to_C", "M :C", colnames(cor_data)) # fix m:c format

if(nrow(cor_data) > 0){
  cor_mat <- rstatix::cor_mat(cor_data)
  cor_p   <- rstatix::cor_pmat(cor_data)

  ggcorrplot(
    cor_mat,
    hc.order = TRUE,
    type = "lower",
    p.mat = cor_p,
    sig.level = 0.05,
    insig = "blank",
    lab = TRUE,
    lab_size = 2.5,
    colors = c("#6D9EC1", "white", "#E46726")
  )
} else {
  cat("Not enough complete data (after drop_na) to compute correlation matrix or PCA.\n")
}

6.1.1 PCA plots

6.2 Seasonal differences - PCA

Do different seasons have distinct chemical/fDOM signatures? Which variables drive those differences?

# original one without benthos (unfaceted)
pca_biplot(
  data_clean,
  vars      = numeric_vars,
  title     = "PCA of Nutrients and fDOM components driving seasonal differences",
  color_var = "Season",
  shape_var = "Day_Night",
  facet_var = "Season"
)

p_pca_season <- pca_biplot(
  data_clean,
  vars      = numeric_vars,
  title     = "PCA of Nutrients and fDOM components driving seasonal differences",
  color_var = "Season",
  shape_var = "Day_Night",
  facet_var = "Benthos"
)

p_pca_season

p_pca_benthos <- pca_biplot(
  data_clean,
  vars = numeric_vars,
  title = "PCA of Nutrients and fDOM components across benthos by season",
  color_var = "Benthos",
  shape_var = "Day_Night",

p_pca_benthos

p_pca_diel <- pca_biplot(
  data_clean,

  shape_var = "Season",
  facet_var = "Day_Night"
)

p_pca_diel

Spring shows strong nutrient and DOM enrichment, can also see diel variability in nutrient accumulation.

7 Dawn vs Dusk analyses across Benthos and Seasons

Start by assessing assumptions of normality and homogeneity of variance.

# create long format df
testing_df <- data_clean %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(numeric_vars),
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "Value")

nutrient_vars <- c("NO3", "PO4", "SIL", "NO2", "NH4", "NOx")

# running lm and creating diagnostic plots
map_dfr(numeric_vars, function(v){
  df_sub <- testing_df %>%
    filter(variable == v) # filter by variable
    options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
    fit <- lm(Value ~ Day_Night * Benthos * Season, data = df_sub)
  par(mfrow = c(2,2)) # create 2x2 for plots
  plot(fit, main = paste("Diagnostics for", v)) # check assumptions using qq and residuals plots
})
## # A tibble: 0 × 0
# NOx, Humic, Prot, HIX looks like they need to be transformed
transform_var <- c("NOx", "Humic", "Prot", "HIX")
transformed_var <- map_dfr(transform_var, function(v){
  testing_df %>%
    filter(variable == v) %>% # filter by variable
    mutate(Value = sqrt(Value),
           variable = paste0(v,"_transformed"))
})

# check that transformations worked
transformed_vars <- c("NOx_transformed", "Humic_transformed", "Prot_transformed", "HIX_transformed")
map_dfr(transformed_vars, function(v){
  df_sub <- transformed_var %>%
    filter(variable == v) # filter by variable
    options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
    fit <- lm(Value ~ Day_Night * Benthos * Season, data = df_sub)
  par(mfrow = c(2,2)) # create 2x2 for plots
  plot(fit, main = paste("Diagnostics for", v)) # check assumptions using qq and residuals plots
})
## # A tibble: 0 × 0

7.1 ANOVA results

testing_df_norm <- bind_rows(testing_df, transformed_var) 
numeric_vars_normal <- c("pH", "TA", "NOx_transformed", "Humic_transformed", "Prot_transformed", "BIX", "HIX_transformed", "M_to_C")

# let's see all ANOVA results together
anovas_full <- map_dfr(numeric_vars_normal, function(v){
  df_sub <- testing_df_norm %>%
    filter(variable == v) # filter by variable
    options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
    fit <- lmer(Value ~ Day_Night * Benthos * Season + (1| Quad_ID), data = df_sub)
    Anova(fit, type = "III") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    filter(`Pr(>Chisq)` < 0.05) %>% # see what's significant
    mutate(variable = v)
})
anovas_full %>%
  kable()

# individual models depending on whether they have random effect

## pH model without random effect
ph_model <- lm(Value ~ Day_Night * Benthos * Season, 
            data = testing_df_norm %>% 
              filter(variable == "pH"))
Anova(ph_model, type = "III")
## Anova Table (Type III tests)
## 
## Response: Value
##                           Sum Sq  Df    F value    Pr(>F)    
## (Intercept)              12195.7   1 2.2873e+06 < 2.2e-16 ***
## Day_Night                    2.6   1 4.8745e+02 < 2.2e-16 ***
## Benthos                      0.1   4 3.3715e+00 0.0107083 *  
## Season                       0.1   1 1.2310e+01 0.0005554 ***
## Day_Night:Benthos            0.1   4 2.5606e+00 0.0397528 *  
## Day_Night:Season             0.2   1 3.0458e+01 1.039e-07 ***
## Benthos:Season               0.1   4 3.9361e+00 0.0042372 ** 
## Day_Night:Benthos:Season     0.1   4 2.7770e+00 0.0281038 *  
## Residuals                    1.1 202                         
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## TA model with random effect
TA_model <- lmer(Value ~ Day_Night * Benthos * Season + (1|Quad_ID), 
            data = testing_df_norm %>% 
              filter(variable == "TA"))
Anova(TA_model)
## Analysis of Deviance Table (Type II Wald chisquare tests)
## 
## Response: Value
##                            Chisq Df Pr(>Chisq)    
## Day_Night                17.9857  1  2.226e-05 ***
## Benthos                  29.5961  4  5.914e-06 ***
## Season                   34.7814  1  3.689e-09 ***

7.2 Diel variability summary statistics

## percent change per benthos
pct_change_df <- testing_df %>%
  filter(variable == "NOx") %>%
  group_by(Season, Benthos, Day_Night) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_val = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Day_Night,
    values_from = c(mean_val, n),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diel_diff = mean_val_Dusk - mean_val_Dawn,
    pct_change = ifelse(mean_val_Dawn == 0, NA_real_,
                        100 * diel_diff / mean_val_Dawn),
    n_total = n_Dawn + n_Dusk
  )

Let’s look at differences across benthos in their dawn/dusk values over the two seasons

8 Heatmap colored in comparison to OO

Calculates means per benthos x season x day/night and compares against the open ocean mean

# take means of all variables
heatmap_data <- data_clean %>%
  group_by(Benthos, Day_Night, Season) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(ratio_vars), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(ratio_vars),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "Mean_Value")

# get open ocean means for comparison
open_ocean_ref <- heatmap_data %>%
  filter(Benthos == "Open Ocean") %>%
  select(-Benthos) %>%
  rename(OpenOcean_Value = Mean_Value)

# join both to calculate ΔOO
fdom_diff <- heatmap_data %>%
  filter(Benthos != "Open Ocean") %>% 
  left_join(open_ocean_ref,
            by = c("Day_Night","Season","variable")) %>%
  mutate(Diff_from_OO = Mean_Value - OpenOcean_Value)

# scale the differences so we can plot it
fdom_diff <- fdom_diff %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  mutate(Diff_Scaled = as.numeric(scale(Diff_from_OO)), # scale function scales AND centers, leading to inconsistencies
         Diff_Scaled_Nocenter = as.numeric(scale(Diff_from_OO, center = FALSE))) %>%  # scales without centering
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Benthos = factor(Benthos, 
    levels = c("Barnacle", "Mussel", "Rockweed", "Surfgrass"))) %>% # order benthos by assigning levels
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, 
    levels =  c("pH", "TA", "NOx", "Humic", "Prot", "BIX", "HIX", "M_to_C") # order variables by assigning levels 
  ))
 #   labels = c("pH", "TA", "NOx", "Humic", "Prot", "BIX", "HIX", "M:C"))) # change label for m:c formatting

# heat map colored by difference from open ocean
fdom_diff %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = variable,
             y = Day_Night,
             fill = Diff_Scaled_Nocenter)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#075AFF", mid = "white", high = "#FF4500",
    midpoint = 0, name = "Scaled difference\nfrom open ocean"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Deviation from Open Ocean fDOM + Nutrients",
    x = "Component",
    y = "Time of day"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_grid(Benthos ~ Season) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

## ANOVA

# filter out NAs
testing_df_norm <- testing_df_norm %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Value))%>%
  mutate(Season = as.factor(Season))

compute_sig_to_ctrl <- function(testing_df_norm, vars = numeric_vars_normal) {
  
  options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly")) # set contrasts for type III ANOVA
  
  res_tbl <- map(vars, function(v) {
    df <- testing_df_norm %>%
      filter(variable == v)
    
    fit <- lm(Value ~ Benthos * Day_Night * Season, data = df) # create lm
    model <- Anova(fit, type = "III")
    emm <- emmeans(fit, ~ Benthos | Day_Night * Season) # emmeans for tukey's hsd
    vs_ctrl <- contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = control_label, adjust = "mvt")
    td  <- as.data.frame(vs_ctrl)
    
    comp_tbl <- td %>%
      separate(contrast, c("left","right"), sep = " - ", remove = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(
        Benthos  = if_else(right == control_label, left, right),
        variable = v,
        sig = case_when(
          is.na(p.value)  ~ NA_character_,
          p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
          p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
          p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
          TRUE            ~ ""
        )
      ) 
    ctrl_tbl <- crossing(
      variable = v,
      Season   = unique(td$Season),
      Day_Night= unique(td$Day_Night),
      Benthos  = control_label
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        estimate = NA_real_, SE = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, t.ratio = NA_real_,
        p.value  = NA_real_, sig = ""
      )

    bind_rows(comp_tbl, ctrl_tbl) %>%
      distinct(variable, Season, Day_Night, Benthos, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }) %>% compact() %>% list_rbind()

  res_tbl
}

sig_to_ctrl <- compute_sig_to_ctrl(testing_df_norm) %>%
  mutate(variable = sub("_transformed$", "", variable)) # convert name back for join


# get n so we can add to the plot
n_table <- testing_df_norm %>%
  mutate(variable = sub("_transformed$", "", variable)) %>%
  group_by(Season, Benthos, variable, Day_Night) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(!is.na(Value)), .groups = "drop")

# join all data for plotting
plot_df <- fdom_diff %>%  
  left_join(sig_to_ctrl, by = c("Season","Day_Night","Benthos","variable")) %>%
  left_join(n_table,   by = c("Season","Day_Night","Benthos","variable"))

# create plot
plot_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = variable,
             y = Day_Night,
             fill = Diff_Scaled_Nocenter)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#075AFF", mid = "white", high = "#FF4500",
    midpoint = 0, name = "Scaled difference\nfrom open ocean"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Dusk vs Dawn fDOM + Nutrients (orig ANOVA)",
    x = "Component",
    y = "Time of day"
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(sig),"",paste0(sig,"\nn\n",n))), color = "black", size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_grid(Benthos ~ Season) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

8.1 One-sample t-test

compute_sig_to_ctrl_ttest <- function(testing_df_norm, 
                                      vars = numeric_vars_normal,
                                      control_label) {
  
  res_tbl <- map(vars, function(v) { # loop for each variable
    df_var <- testing_df_norm %>%
      filter(variable == v)
    
    res_by_sd <- df_var %>%
      group_nest(Season, Day_Night) %>% # group by season and dawn/dusk
      mutate(
        res = map(data, function(df_sd) {
          ctrl_vals <- df_sd %>%
            filter(Benthos == control_label) %>%
            pull(Value)
          ctrl_mean <- mean(ctrl_vals, na.rm = TRUE) # get OO mean

          df_sd %>%
            group_by(Benthos) %>%
            summarise(
              n       = sum(!is.na(Value)),
              mean    = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop"
            ) %>%
            mutate(
              # one-sample test vs control mean for each benthos
              p.value = map_dbl(Benthos, function(b) {
                x <- df_sd %>% filter(Benthos == b) %>% pull(Value)
                t.test(x, mu = ctrl_mean)$p.value
              }),
              estimate = mean - ctrl_mean,
              variable = v
            )
        })
      ) %>%
      select(-data) %>%
      unnest(res)
    
    # add sig stars
    res_by_sd %>%
      mutate(
        sig = case_when(
          is.na(p.value)  ~ NA_character_,
          p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
          p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
          p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
          TRUE            ~ ""
        )
      )
  }) %>% 
    compact() %>% 
    list_rbind()
  
  res_tbl
}

sig_to_ctrl_ttest <- compute_sig_to_ctrl_ttest(testing_df_norm,
                                               vars = numeric_vars_normal,
                                               control_label = control_label) %>%
  mutate(variable = sub("_transformed$", "", variable))

plot_df_ttest <- fdom_diff %>%
  left_join(sig_to_ctrl_ttest, 
            by = c("Season","Day_Night","Benthos","variable"))

# create plot
plot_df_ttest %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = variable,
             y = Day_Night,
             fill = Diff_Scaled_Nocenter)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#075AFF", mid = "white", high = "#FF4500",
    midpoint = 0, name = "Scaled difference\nfrom open ocean"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Dusk vs Dawn fDOM + Nutrients (t-test vs open ocean)",
    x = "Component",
    y = "Time of day"
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(sig), "", paste0(sig, "\nn\n", n))),
            color = "black", size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_grid(Benthos ~ Season) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text  = element_text(size = 10)
  )

8.2 Dunn’s test

compute_sig_to_ctrl_dunn <- function(testing_df_norm, 
                                     vars = numeric_vars,
                                     control_label) {
  
  res_tbl <- map(vars, function(v) { # loop for each variable
    df_var <- testing_df_norm %>%
      filter(variable == v)
    
    df_var %>%
      group_by(Season, Day_Night) %>% # group by season and dawn/dusk
      group_modify(~ {
        df_sd <- .x
  
        dunn_res <- df_sd %>%
          rstatix::dunn_test(Value ~ Benthos, p.adjust.method = "none")
        
        # keep only comparisons involving OO
        dunn_ctrl <- dunn_res %>%
          filter(group1 == control_label | group2 == control_label) %>%
          mutate(
            Benthos  = if_else(group1 == control_label, group2, group1),
            variable = v,
            p.value  = p.adj
          )
        
        dunn_ctrl
      }) %>%
      ungroup()
  }) %>%
    compact() %>%
    list_rbind() %>%
    mutate(
      sig = case_when(
        is.na(p.value)  ~ NA_character_,
        p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE            ~ ""
      )
    )
  
  res_tbl
}

9 Create effect size plots

build_diel_effect_df_one_scaled <- function(var_name, data = data_clean) {
  stopifnot(var_name %in% names(data))
  
  # scale the variable (global z-score)
  data_z <- data %>%
    mutate(var_z = as.numeric(scale(.data[[var_name]])))
  
  fml <- as.formula("var_z ~ Day_Night * Season * Benthos + (1|Quad_ID)")
  fit <- lmer(fml, data = data_z)
  
  # emmeans for Day_Night within each Season × Benthos
  emm <- emmeans(fit, ~ Day_Night | Season * Benthos)
  
  # Dusk - Dawn contrast in *scaled units* (≈ SD units)
  diel <- contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise")
  
  # summary with p-values + 95% CI
  df <- summary(diel, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), level = 0.95) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  # standardize CI names
  if (!"lower.CL" %in% names(df)) {
    if ("asymp.LCL" %in% names(df)) {
      df <- df %>%
        rename(
          lower.CL = asymp.LCL,
          upper.CL = asymp.UCL
        )
    } else if ("LCL" %in% names(df)) {
      df <- df %>%
        rename(
          lower.CL = LCL,
          upper.CL = UCL
        )
    }
  }
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      est_std   = estimate,     
      lower_std = lower.CL,
      upper_std = upper.CL,
      variable  = var_name
    )
}

effects_all <- map_dfr(

)

    ),
    variable = factor(variable, levels = rev(ratio_vars))
  )

10 Diel boxplots with significance levels

build_sig_df <- function(var_name = ratio_vars, data = data_clean) {
  stopifnot(var_name %in% names(data))
  
  # fit ANOVA
  fml <- as.formula(paste(var_name, "~ Day_Night * Season * Benthos + (1|Quad_ID)"))
  fit <- lmer(fml, data = data)
  
  # Dawn vs Dusk within each Season × Benthos
  emm  <- emmeans(fit, ~ Day_Night | Season * Benthos)
  contr_df <- as.data.frame(contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise"))
  # columns: Season, Benthos, contrast, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value
  
  # Turn p-values into stars
  sig_df <- contr_df %>%
    select(Season, Benthos, p.value) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    )) %>%
    left_join(
      data %>%
        group_by(Season, Benthos) %>%
        summarise(y_pos = max(.data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
                  .groups = "drop"),
      by = c("Season", "Benthos")
    ) %>%
    mutate(y_pos = y_pos * 1.05) %>% # a bit above top whisker
    filter(sig != "ns")
}

plot_diel_with_sig <- function(var_name, var_label, 
                               data = data_clean,
                               free_y = FALSE) {
  stopifnot(var_name %in% names(data))
  
  sig_df <- build_sig_df(var_name, data = data)
  
  facet_scales <- if (free_y) "free_y" else "fixed"
  
  ggplot(
    data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[var_name]])),
    aes(x = Day_Night, y = .data[[var_name]], fill = Day_Night)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
    facet_grid(rows = vars(Season),cols = vars(Benthos),
              scales = facet_scales,switch = "y"
) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Dawn" = "#FDB813", "Dusk" = "#003865")) +
    labs(
      #title = paste("Diel Patterns in", var_label),
      x = "Sampling Time",
      y = var_label
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
      strip.placement = "outside",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = sig_df,
      aes(x = 1.5, y = y_pos, label = sig),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 4
    )
}

11 Diel plots with triangles

build_tri_df <- function(var_name,
                         data = data_clean,
                         control_label = "Open Ocean",
                         y_pad = 1.07,          
                         p_cut = 0.05,
                         adjust = "holm") {

  stopifnot(var_name %in% names(data))

  # fit model
  fml <- as.formula(paste(var_name, "~ Day_Night * Season * Benthos + (1|Quad_ID)"))
  fit <- lmer(fml, data = data)

  # emmeans for Benthos within each Season × Day_Night
  emm_b <- emmeans(fit, ~ Benthos | Season * Day_Night)

  # compare each benthos to control within each Season × Day_Night
  ctrl_contr <- as.data.frame(
    contrast(emm_b, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = control_label, adjust = adjust)
  )

  tri_df <- ctrl_contr %>%
    # pull the benthos name out of the contrast label
    mutate(
      Benthos = gsub(paste0(" - ", control_label, "$"), "", contrast),
      direction = case_when(
        p.value < p_cut & estimate > 0 ~ "up",
        p.value < p_cut & estimate < 0 ~ "down",
        TRUE                           ~ "ns"
      ),
      tri = case_when(
        direction == "up"   ~ "\u25B2",  # ▲
        direction == "down" ~ "\u25BC",  # ▼
        TRUE                ~ ""
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(Benthos != control_label) %>%
    # y-position: just above max in that facet for that Day_Night
    left_join(
      data %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[var_name]])) %>%
        group_by(Season, Day_Night, Benthos) %>%
        summarise(y_pos = max(.data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
      by = c("Season", "Day_Night", "Benthos")
    ) %>%
    mutate(y_pos = y_pos * y_pad)

  tri_df
}

# create space for the triangles
build_facet_tops <- function(var_name, data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var_name]])) %>%
    group_by(Season, Benthos) %>%
    summarise(
      y_max = max(.data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
      y_min = min(.data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
      y_rng = y_max - y_min,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      y_rng = ifelse(y_rng == 0 | is.na(y_rng), abs(y_max) * 0.1 + 1e-6, y_rng),
      tri_y  = y_max + 0.4 * y_rng,   # lower annotation row
      star_y = y_max + 0.1 * y_rng    # upper annotation row
    )
}

plot_diel_with_sig <- function(var_name, var_label,
                               data = data_clean,
                               control_label = "Open Ocean",
                               free_y = FALSE) {

  benthos_levels <- c("Open Ocean", "Barnacle", "Mussel", "Rockweed", "Surfgrass")

  data2 <- data %>%
    mutate(Benthos = factor(Benthos, levels = benthos_levels))

  tops <- build_facet_tops(var_name, data2) %>%
    mutate(Benthos = factor(Benthos, levels = benthos_levels))

  sig_df <- build_sig_df(var_name, data = data2) %>%
    mutate(Benthos = factor(Benthos, levels = benthos_levels)) %>%
    left_join(tops %>% select(Season, Benthos, star_y), by = c("Season","Benthos")) %>%
    mutate(y_pos = star_y)

  tri_df <- build_tri_df(var_name, data = data2, control_label = control_label) %>%
    mutate(Benthos = factor(Benthos, levels = benthos_levels)) %>%
    left_join(tops %>% select(Season, Benthos, tri_y), by = c("Season","Benthos")) %>%
    mutate(y_pos = tri_y)

  facet_scales <- if (free_y) "free_y" else "fixed"
  y_expand <- expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25))

  ggplot(
    data2 %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[var_name]])),
    aes(x = Day_Night, y = .data[[var_name]], fill = Day_Night)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
    facet_grid(rows = vars(Season), cols = vars(Benthos),
               scales = facet_scales, switch = "y") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = y_expand) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Dawn" = "#FDB813", "Dusk" = "#003865")) +
    labs(x = "Sampling Time", y = var_label) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
      strip.placement = "outside",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = tri_df,
      aes(x = Day_Night, y = y_pos, label = tri),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 4
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = sig_df,
      aes(x = 1.5, y = y_pos, label = sig),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 4
    )
}

12 Diel plots with colors

build_relation_df <- function(var_name, data, control_label = "Open Ocean", p_cut = 0.05, adjust = "holm") {
  stopifnot(var_name %in% names(data))
  fml <- as.formula(paste(var_name, "~ Day_Night * Season * Benthos + (1|Quad_ID)"))
  fit <- lmer(fml, data = data)
  emm_b <- emmeans(fit, ~ Benthos | Season * Day_Night)
  ctrl_contr <- as.data.frame(contrast(emm_b, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = control_label, adjust = adjust))
  rel_df <- ctrl_contr %>%
    mutate(
      Benthos = gsub(paste0(" - ", control_label, "$"), "", contrast),
      relation = case_when(
        p.value < p_cut & estimate > 0 ~ "Higher",
        p.value < p_cut & estimate < 0 ~ "Lower",
        TRUE                           ~ "Similar"
      ),
      sig_flag = if_else(!is.na(p.value) & p.value < p_cut, "sig", "ns")
    ) %>%
    select(Season, Day_Night, Benthos, estimate, p.value, relation, sig_flag)
  # ensure control rows exist and tagged as "control"
  seasons <- unique(rel_df$Season)
  days <- unique(rel_df$Day_Night)
  control_rows <- expand.grid(Season = seasons, Day_Night = days, Benthos = control_label, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(estimate = 0, p.value = NA_real_, relation = "control", sig_flag = "sig")
  bind_rows(rel_df, control_rows) %>%
  mutate(
    relation = case_when(
      relation %in% c("Similar", "control") ~ "Same",
      TRUE                                  ~ as.character(relation)
    ),
    relation = factor(relation, levels = c("Higher", "Same", "Lower")),
    sig_flag = factor(sig_flag, levels = c("sig", "ns"))
  )
}

# function to create plot
plot_diel_fill_intensity <- function(var_name, var_label, data = data_clean,
                                     control_label = "Open Ocean",
                                     free_y = FALSE) {
  stopifnot(var_name %in% names(data))
  
  # create order benthos should appear in
  benthos_levels <- c("Open Ocean", "Barnacle", "Mussel", "Rockweed", "Surfgrass")
  
  # compute relation (per Season x Day_Night x Benthos)
  rel_df <- build_relation_df(var_name, data, control_label = control_label)
  
  # existing stars from earlier in code (Dawn vs Dusk)
  sig_df <- build_sig_df(var_name, data = data)
  
  # Prepare row-level data and enforce factor levels consistently
  data2 <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var_name]])) %>%
    mutate(
      Benthos   = factor(Benthos, levels = benthos_levels),
      Day_Night = factor(Day_Night, levels = c("Dawn", "Dusk"))
    ) %>%
    left_join(rel_df, by = c("Season", "Day_Night", "Benthos")) %>%
    mutate(
      relation   = factor(relation, levels = c("Higher", "Same", "Lower")),
      fill_group = factor(
        paste(Day_Night, relation, sep = "_"),
        levels = time_rel_levels
      )
    )
  
  # enforce same factor levels for rel_df and sig_df so facets align
  rel_df <- rel_df %>% mutate(Benthos = factor(Benthos, levels = benthos_levels))
  sig_df <- sig_df %>% mutate(Benthos = factor(Benthos, levels = benthos_levels))
  
   # If some combinations are missing in your data, ensure they are present in the scale or provide na.value.
  facet_scales <- if (free_y) "free_y" else "fixed"
  
  ggplot(data2 %>% mutate(Benthos = factor(Benthos, levels = benthos_levels)),
         aes(x = Day_Night, y = .data[[var_name]])) +
    # use fill_group as the box fill (intensity encodes relation)
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = fill_group), outlier.shape = NA, size = 0.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
    # keep alpha constant for points and boxes
    geom_jitter(aes(fill = fill_group), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.8) +
    facet_grid(rows = vars(Season), cols = vars(Benthos), scales = facet_scales, switch = "y", drop = FALSE) +
    # map fill groups to our chosen color palette
    common_fill_scale +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    # hide separate Day_Night legend since fill encodes both; if you want a simple Day_Night legend, create a manual guide below
    labs(x = "Sampling Time", y = var_label) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
      strip.placement = "outside",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    ) +
    # add the stars for Dawn vs Dusk
    geom_text(data = sig_df, aes(x = 1.5, y = y_pos, label = sig), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4)
}

# okay, well does there seem to be an effect regardless of season?
anovas_full_ebb <- map_dfr(numeric_vars_normal, function(v){
  df_sub <- testing_df_norm %>%
    filter(variable == v) # filter by variable
    options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
    fit <- lm(Value ~ Day_Night * Benthos + Tide, data = df_sub)
    Anova(fit, type = "III") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    filter(`Pr(>F)` < 0.05) %>% # see what's significant
    mutate(variable = v)
})

# lets look at all numeric vars just in case

# fall dusk = pH and humics
anovas_full_tidal_fall <- map_dfr(numeric_vars_normal, function(v){
  df_sub <- testing_df_norm %>%
    filter(variable == v,
           Season == "Fall",
          Day_Night == "Dusk")
    options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
    fit <- lm(Value ~ Tide, data = df_sub)
    Anova(fit, type = "III") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    filter(`Pr(>F)` < 0.05) %>% # see what's significant
    mutate(variable = v)
})

# spring nothing
anovas_full_tidal_spring <- map_dfr(numeric_vars_normal, function(v){
  df_sub <- testing_df_norm %>%
    filter(variable == v,
           Season == "Spring",
          Day_Night == "Dawn")
    options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
    fit <- lm(Value ~ Tide, data = df_sub)
    Anova(fit, type = "III") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    filter(`Pr(>F)` < 0.05) %>% # see what's significant
    mutate(variable = v)
})

14 Regressions

14.1 pH and nitrogen

In the fall, nitrification drives down pH (as NH4 -> NO3). In the spring, higher NOx indicates strong photosynthetic signals which increase pH

# pH and nitrates - which is driving which?
ggplot(data_clean %>% 
         filter(Benthos != "Open Ocean"), aes(x = log(NOx), y = pH)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Benthos)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~Season,
    scales = "free_x"
  ) # surfgrass 7.7 pH weird

14.2 HIX and BIX

# HIX and BIX are correlated with each other, makes sense. There is either more fresh/labile DOM (BIX) or more complex DOM (HIX).

14.3 Consumer nutrient analysis

# regression of nitrogens
nitrogenmodel <- lm(log(NOx) ~ log(NH4) * Day_Night * Benthos * Season,
  data = data_clean
)
Anova(nitrogenmodel, type = "III")

  labs(
    x = expression(paste("NH"[4]," (µmol L"^-1,")")),
    color = "Sampling Time"
  ) +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_blank(), strip.background.x = element_blank())

nitrogenplot + nh4hixplot + 
  plot_layout(axes = "collect", guides = "collect", ncol = 1)

#ggsave(here("Output","ConsumerPlot.png"), width = 12, height = 10)

15 Community Composition

15.1 Sessile

## sum across the canopy and understory ###

sessile_total <-sessile %>%
  group_by(plot, season)%>%
  summarise_at(.vars = vars(Silvetia_compressa:Chondracanthus_canaliculatus), .funs = sum)%>% 
  mutate(Total_hairs = rowSums(across(Silvetia_compressa:Chondracanthus_canaliculatus))) %>% # count total crosshairs
  ungroup()%>% # calculate percent cover
  mutate(across(c(Silvetia_compressa:Chondracanthus_canaliculatus),  ~ . /Total_hairs*100))%>%
  rename(BenthicID = plot, Season = season)%>% # keep consistent with other data
  mutate(Season = factor(Season, levels = c("summer2023","fall2023","winter2024", "spring2024")))%>%
  mutate(Benthos = case_when( # add benthos name
    grepl("B", BenthicID) ~ "Barnacles",
    grepl("M", BenthicID) ~"Mussels",
    grepl("P", BenthicID) ~"Surfgrass",
    grepl("R", BenthicID) ~"Rockweed"), 
    .after = BenthicID)


## Make a stacked barplot of all the species across seasons
sessile_total %>%
  group_by(Benthos, Season)%>% # calculate the average for each season
  summarise(across(c(Silvetia_compressa:Chondracanthus_canaliculatus),  ~mean(.,na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Silvetia_compressa:Chondracanthus_canaliculatus), names_to = "Species", values_to = "Percent_Cover")%>%
  left_join(sessile_function)%>%
  filter(Season %in% c('fall2023','spring2024')) %>%
  mutate(Season = factor(Season, 
    levels =  c("fall2023", "spring2024"), 
    labels = c("Fall", "Spring"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Season,y = Percent_Cover, fill = FunctionalGroup ))+
    geom_bar(position="stack", stat="identity")+
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("MetBrewer::Signac")+
  labs(x = "",
       y = "% Cover",
       color = "",
       fill = "Functional Group")+
  theme_bw()+
  facet_wrap(~Benthos)

#ggsave(here("Output","SessileComp.png"), width = 10, height = 6)

15.2 Mobiles

## calculate denisity per m2 (used 0.25m2 quad)
mobile_density <-
  mobile %>%
  rename(BenthicID = plot, Season = season)%>% # keep consistent with other data
  mutate(Season = factor(Season, levels = c("summer2023","fall2023","winter2024","spring2024")))%>%
  mutate(Benthos = case_when( # add benthos name
    grepl("B", BenthicID) ~ "Barnacles",
    grepl("M", BenthicID) ~"Mussels",
    grepl("P", BenthicID) ~"Surfgrass",
    grepl("R", BenthicID) ~"Rockweed"), 
    .after = BenthicID)%>%
  select(-c(Littorina_sp_raw, Lottia_sp_raw))%>%
  mutate(across(c(Lottia_sp_scaled:Strongylocentrotus_purpuratus),  ~./0.25))
  

mobile_density %>%
  group_by(Benthos, Season)%>% # calculate the average for each season
  summarise(across(c(Lottia_sp_scaled:Strongylocentrotus_purpuratus),  ~mean(.,na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Lottia_sp_scaled:Strongylocentrotus_purpuratus), names_to = "Species", values_to = "Density_m2")%>%
  left_join(mobile_function)%>% #join with functional data
  filter(Season %in% c('fall2023','spring2024')) %>%
  mutate(Season = factor(Season, 
    levels =  c("fall2023", "spring2024"), 
    labels = c("Fall", "Spring"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Season,y = Density_m2, fill = FunctionalGroup ))+
  geom_bar(position="stack", stat="identity")+
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("MetBrewer::Signac")+
  labs(x = "",
       y = expression(paste("Mean Density (m"^2,")")),
       color = "",
       fill = "Functional Group")+
  theme_bw()+
  facet_wrap(~Benthos, scale = "free")

## rename the foundation species data to match the chemistry
sessile_clean<-sessile_total %>%
  rename(Quad_ID = BenthicID) %>%
  mutate(Season = case_when(Season  == "fall2023"~"Fall",
                            Season == "spring2024"~"Spring",
                            Season == "summer2023"~"Summer",
                            Season == "winter2024"~"Winter")) %>%
  mutate(FoundationSp = case_when(Benthos == "Barnacles"~ `Balanus/Cthamalus_sp`,
                                   Benthos == "Rockweed"~Silvetia_compressa,
                                   Benthos == "Surfgrass"~Phyllospadix_sp,
                                   Benthos == "Mussels"~Mytilus_californianus)) %>%  # add a column that is the cover of the foundation species for the right benthos
  select(!Total_hairs) %>%
  mutate(Benthos = ifelse(Benthos == "Mussels","Mussel",Benthos))%>%
  mutate(Benthos = ifelse(Benthos == "Barnacles","Barnacle",Benthos))
